purpose: Teach: 印紙/新法/極論/由緒/疑義/客員/総評/携え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約書に必要な印紙を貼れ
lines.en: Make sure we affix the required revenue stamps to the contract.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Brief pause after the opening. Low pitch, no inflection—authority that doesn't need to perform. Eyes on the document, not the person.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新法の施行に備えます
lines.en: Understood. We'll be ready for the new regulation rollout.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Slight nod on the opening word. Clear, measured tone—demonstrating competence without overstatement. Notes being filed away mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、極論に走らず冷静に判断しろ
lines.en: Don't jump to extremes. Stay calm and think this through carefully.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weight on 'calm'—a gentle correction. Steady eye contact. Voice carries the weight of experience, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の由緒ある歴史を強調します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we emphasize the depth of our company's history and standing.
lines.style: Focused, affirmative. Slight lean forward. Tone is serious, measured—showing he's absorbed the direction and ready to act on it with weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 株主からの疑義に丁寧に回答しろ
lines.en: Respond to shareholder concerns with careful attention to detail and courtesy.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Eyes narrow slightly with emphasis. Voice carries quiet insistence—this matters. No room for carelessness here.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。客員研究員を社内に招きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll bring in a visiting researcher to strengthen our internal expertise.
lines.style: Assured tone. Slight uptick in energy—showing initiative, not just compliance. Words land with quiet confidence that this is a smart move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界誌の総評記事を確認しろ
lines.en: Review the industry publications' coverage of us thoroughly. Make sure we're not missing anything.
lines.style: Authoritative, unhurried. Slight pause before the second thought. Voice stays level—this is standard due diligence, but it matters. Expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の使命を携えて新事業に臨みます
lines.en: Understood. I'll carry our company's mission forward as we move into these new ventures.
lines.style: Steady, almost solemn. Voice gains quiet conviction on 'mission'—this is bigger than the individual instruction. Closing statement carries the weight of commitment.
